Vertical vs Horizontal Scaling: Scale Up or Scale Out?

Quick thread 🧵
Vertical scaling (scale up) means a bigger server: more CPU and RAM on one box, no code change.
Horizontal scaling (scale out) means more servers sharing the work behind a load balancer, which needs a stateless app.
Scale up first, because it's simple and buys real runway.
Scale out when you hit a single box's ceiling or you need redundancy, since one server is a single point of failure.
